## GHO Homes Continues Streak with Sixth Consecutive Builder of the Year Award


August 26, 2026


Download (opens in new window)


PORT ST. LUCIE, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


GRBK GHO Homes, LLC d/b/a GHO Homes, a subsidiary of Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK), has earned the Builder of the Year award for the sixth consecutive year from the Treasure Coast Community Choice Awards. The Treasure Coast Community Choice Award celebrates local businesses and organizations that have made an impact on the region. Driven entirely by public nominations and votes, the recognition reflects the enduring trust that Treasure Coast residents place in GHO Homes, a homebuilder with more than four decades of building communities in the Treasure Coast area.


Bill Handler, President of GHO Homes, said, "This honor speaks volumes about the dedication of our team and the trust our homeowners place in us. We are humbled by the continuing support from the community and look forward to building even more homes that enhance lives and neighborhoods. We are grateful to everyone who voted and continues to support our mission."


Founded in 1983 by Dan Handler and now led by his son, Bill Handler, GHO Homes has evolved from a family-owned operation into one of the Treasure Coast’s most respected homebuilders. Headquartered in Port St. Lucie, the company is known for creating homes that seamlessly blend timeless architectural design with modern functionality. Through its signature Tailor-Made program, homebuyers can personalize their residences with an extensive selection of floor plans, built-in features, upgrades, and custom finishes. The company's experienced design studio team guides buyers through every step of the selection process within its expansive 4,351- square-foot design studio.


**About GHO Homes**


GHO Homes has been building homes since 1983 and became affiliated with Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK) in 2018. GHO Homes focus its building efforts in highly desirable neighborhoods along Florida’s Treasure Coast. Boasting more than 60 floorplans with hundreds of “Tailor Made” options and a 4,351-square-foot Design Studio, GHO Homes has created a unique opportunity for home buyers to create a custom feel to their homes. The Design Studio provides access for customers to some of the latest design trends, features and quality finishes.


For more information about GHO Homes and to explore available communities across the Treasure Coast, visit[GHOHomes.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ghohomes.com%2F&esheet=54595133&newsitemid=20260826184639&lan=en-US&anchor=GHOHomes.com&index=1&md5=8da2251c18655ff6ca865039edfe86a3)


**About Green Brick Partners, Inc** .


Green Brick Partners, Inc (NYSE: GRBK), the third largest homebuilder in Dallas-Fort Worth, is a diversified homebuilding and land development company that operates through its seven subsidiary homebuilders in Texas, Georgia, and Florida. Green Brick owns five subsidiary homebuilders in Texas (CB JENI Homes, Normandy Homes, Southgate Homes, Trophy Signature Homes, and a 90% interest in Centre Living Homes), as well as a controlling interest in a homebuilder in Atlanta, Georgia (The Providence Group) and an 80% interest in a homebuilder in Port St. Lucie, Florida (GHO Homes). Green Brick also retains interest in related financial services platforms, including Green Brick Title, Green Brick Mortgage, and Green Brick Insurance. Green Brick is engaged in all aspects of the homebuilding process, including land acquisition and development, entitlements, design, construction, marketing, and sales for its residential neighborhoods and master-planned communities. For more information about Green Brick Partners Inc.’s subsidiary homebuilders, please visit[https://greenbrickpartners.com/brands-services/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fgreenbrickpartners.com%2Fbrands-services%2F&esheet=54595133&newsitemid=20260826184639&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fgreenbrickpartners.com%2Fbrands-services%2F&index=2&md5=f246c3ab7a25300f377adb84654eb540) .
